title: terragucci.estates/v1
description: estates.json at the top of a reports prefix: each estate whose roster a tf-apply wave or an estate migration wrote, with its resource count. Within v1 fields are only added, and an existing field never changes meaning.

estate.description: The estate a choudoufu root's live block names, or a stock root's path.

count.description: How many resources the roster holds.

at.description: When the roster was read: the wave's end, or the migration's write.

roster.description: The roster's key, relative to estates.json: estates/<estate>/roster.json.
